subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
specific_objectives: 15.1.8.5 Trainee will be able to explain Synchro torque pressure indicating system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of system schematic diagrams and verification of torque pressure indication principles against IB data; Safety: Ensure no live electrical connections are simulated; Supervision: Instructor monitors diagram interpretation accuracy.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a synchro torque system?
How does pressure indication differ from direct pressure measurement?
Why is torque required in pressure-indicating synchro systems?

development.content:
System overview and components
Synchro torque generation principles
Pressure sensing mechanism integration
Signal transmission and indication
System calibration and zeroing

topics: Impact of torque failure on indication
development.content:
Operational sequence analysis
Fault detection and isolation
Maintenance and troubleshooting procedures
Impact of torque failure on indication
Safety considerations during operation

Real-world application scenarios
Comparison with alternative systems
Performance limitations and constraints
Future developments in torque systems
Regulatory compliance and standards

summary_questions: Explain the role of torque in the pressure-indicating synchro system.
Describe the steps involved in troubleshooting a torque failure.
How does the system ensure accurate pressure indication under varying loads?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report comparing the synchro torque pressure-indicating system with the engine vibration monitoring system covered in LP 24, highlighting key operational differences.
